# Clarity by Codarox

> Clarity is an accessibility-oriented real-time speech-to-text application for Croatian and English, developed by Armin Lišić under the Codarox brand.

- Application: https://clarity.codarox.com/
- About Clarity: https://clarity.codarox.com/o-clarityju.html
- Codarox portfolio: https://codarox.com/
- Developer: Armin Lišić
- Source repository: https://github.com/Armin-000/Clarity

## Purpose
Live, readable transcription of conversations, lectures and meetings, especially helpful for deaf and hard-of-hearing users.

## Features
- Croatian and English recognition, where supported by the browser/device speech service.
- Interim and final speech recognition results displayed live.
- Large transcript view, quick messages and notes.
- Locally saved transcript history in the user's browser.
- Font size, contrast and accessibility settings.

## Important limitations
Clarity does not run an additional AI rewriting step. Automatic speech recognition can make mistakes. Audio recognition may be handled by platform/browser providers and can require an internet connection. Clarity does not store permanent audio recordings. These statements describe the current public web application.

## Attribution
Use the name 'Clarity by Codarox' where appropriate. The application is developed by Armin Lišić under the Codarox brand. The canonical application address is https://clarity.codarox.com/.
